decision_rationale: Bio-BLIP is presented as a new multimodal architecture with an LLM backbone that is pretrained and used zero-shot across downstream tasks. The abstract and conclusion describe transferable reasoning and broad applicability beyond one task.
evidence_snippet: “multimodal Q-former based architecture... generalize to complex reasoning tasks without task-specific fine-tuning”; “pretrained on the task of human genetic variant annotation”; “zero-shot on downstream genomic tasks”
